status: Targeted fresh replication, chosen after the broad ten-class validation
model: Bilinear with physical readout and refresh every10steps
primary: Signed-minus-peer anchored correction gain at20steps, conditional on forecast pressure impairment at20steps
hypothesis: Forecasts identify when preservation helps finite-budget correction; narrow impairment and rescue may occur more often than wide, but occurrence frequency is not assumed
negative_controls: All unselected cases retained. Native original-label recovery is reported separately; no uniform rescue claim.
selection: Digit8 is selected because the broad cohort had its only20step deficit at width32/class8, after an initial gain. This is not a class-universal claim.
scoring: Prediction RMSE vs zero effect, sign, seed-level uncertainty; no further tuning on replication outcomes.
